memoryScope: WASM linear memory only; excludes JS heap and compiled code.
scope: Actual published Temporal namespace. Default TS uses compact ICU4X lunisolar data/arithmetic, host Intl Umm al-Qura and named timezones. WASM delegates ISO/Instant/PlainTime/calendar/timezone/Duration math, plain/zoned/short-date arithmetic, string parsing and date formatting with16 native calendars and all IANA records; object semantics and host/Intl integration remain JS/TS. Native-data profile removes duplicated TS calendar/IANA tables; hybrid retains compact TS calendars. ISO date and zoned workloads use basic reference; no non-ISO throughput claim. Transition cases use512 iterations and128 warmup. References temporal-polyfill1.0.7 basic and @js-temporal/polyfill0.5.1. Binary WASM operations return complete records with cached derived fields; JS retains observable object/coercion/option semantics.
method: Eight inputs, parity checked, 3000 warmup +7 samples x10000 calls; TS then WASM with fallback data then WASM with native data only then temporal-polyfill then @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1 in one process. First native/calendar/timezone calls measured separately after warmed JS/TS; calendar call includes registry validation. Hot operations exclude startup. timeParse/timeAdd read nanosecond; timeRoundFormat includes formatting. Gzip level9, esbuild es2022 minification. Separately compressed module sums and consumer bundles are alternative delivery modes.
